construction_notes.text: City permit layer: PRE25-126 (Prelim - Enhanced) at 1563 El Dorado St, APN 015-03-028, filed 2025-03-26, status Complete, zoning CP(PD), applicant Deena Morsilli (HMH). Description: preliminary review for the demolition of multiple buildings, including the Wade House, a designated City Landmark and Contributing Structure, and multiple Identified Structures in the Alviso National Register District, for the construction of 59 (the layer's text ends there).
County parcel data: APN 015-03-028 has situs 1513 El Dorado St; APN 015-03-041 has situs 1563 El Dorado St.

City permit layer, earlier filings at 1641 El Dorado St (APNs 015-03-020 and 015-03-022): HP22-002 Historic Preservation Permit approved 2022-06-22 (owner listed as Anderson Sandra L Trustee); HPA22-002-01 approved 2023-02-15 (Garden City Construction) amending conditions on salvage and storage of historic bricks; PRE18-095, PRE20-068 (Wade Warehouse renovation), PRE21-023 (indoor sports facility) and PRE23-122 (community center) preliminary reviews.

The Mercury News (May 9, 2025, per Ground News summary): dozens of homes could be built on a site at 1563 to 1641 El Dorado Street near the former Vahl's Restaurant; the site holds a mix of residences, industrial uses and commercial activity.
Avison Young marketing site lists 1563-1641 El Dorado Street as a 3.7-acre land offering with an offering memorandum.
